claim_summary: Plan ARIA-V3 validation cycle 2026-05-15 — Plan ARIA-V2 (HEAD d16589c0, 1561/1561 kernel tests green) closed 8 architectural defects + 37 supplementary findings but the autonomous self-closing loop (problem → draft → sandbox → merge) still required operator intervention at four chokepoints (GAP-1..4) + DEBT-2026-05-08-001 (HIGH, due 2026-06-07) blocked live `claude code agent` CLI argv contract. 6-agent autonomous-loop research + 4-agent plan audit absorbed 47 findings (8 original + 14 audit-CRITICAL/HIGH + 25 supplementary). Plan ARIA-V3 corrective-arc ships 10 phases (A0..A5 + B0..B3) closing all 47 findings + retiring DEBT-2026-05-08-001 via Tier-1 architectural fixes paired with 60+ load-bearing invariant tests. Strategy B — Full L3 autonomy on snowball lane: kernel drafts + sandboxes + materializes + merges autonomously under `autonomous` runtime profile when L3 gates pass (diff classifier + green CI + zero requested changes + clear conversations); operator intervenes only on escalation or non-L3 lanes. SPEC §0.2 + §3 + §5.4 amended with ADR-016. Worker_executor.py subprocess boundary preserved (kernel never invokes Agent() directly).

evidences.summary: GAP-1 + GAP-4 ROOT CAUSE — `materialize_*` hard-coded `if not acknowledge: raise GovernanceError`; `genesis_policy.materialization_requires_acknowledge` flag exists but dead config. `_render_agent_markdown` + `_render_skill` emit template-only content (declarative metadata + section headers + 3 hardcoded checklist bullets); operator must fill body manually.

GAP-2 + GAP-3 ROOT CAUSE — `auto_merge_runner=None` default skips auto-merge; `github_adapter=None` default makes verified assignments terminate at `verified_pending_merge`. Worker scheduler never passes adapter.

DEBT-2026-05-08-001 ROOT CAUSE — `claude code agent --subagent-type X --prompt-file Y --output-path Z --max-turns 12 --max-requests 30 --timeout-seconds 1800` argv UNVERIFIED against live Claude Code CLI. `CLAUDE_CODE_MOCK=true` is the only fully-tested mode. OPERATOR_BLOCKED status.

SPEC constraints absorbed: §0.2 Hard Limit 'Never auto-merges except Level 3 snowball lane (squash only, opt-in)'; §3 L3 lane exclusion list (auth/tenant/migrations/infra/secrets/billing/production/aria-kernel); §5.4 'ARIA never invokes these agents (it does not have Agent tool in its kernel)'. V3 amends §0.2 + §3 + §5.4 paired with ADR-016 to explicitly permit auto-materialization on L3 lane under `autonomous` profile via worker_executor subprocess boundary.

Plan ARIA-V3 CONVERGED state: 10 phases ordered A0 → A1 → A2 → A3 → A5 → A4 → B0 → B1 → B2 → B3 (A5 before A4 reorder per test-runner audit). 47 findings closed (8 original + 14 audit-CRITICAL/HIGH + 25 supplementary). 60+ invariant tests. Tier-1 ceiling for all kernel-immutability invariants (resolved-realpath + worktree-normalized). Single SSoT for diff classifier + Gate. Lane kernel-derived. HMAC key custody + rotation. Cost + failure circuit breakers co-equal.
